## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Program Partners shall ensure that all necessary arrangements are made to identify any hazardous exposure that may endanger the health of its or its Subcontractors' Personnel, and that precautionary measures have been taken to protect Personnel and the workplace. This shall include health surveillance programs as required.

## 2.4.3.4.1. Health Surveillance:

- Health surveillance is a system of ongoing health checks. These health checks may be required for employees who are exposed to noise or vibration, ionizing radiation, solvents, fumes, dusts, biological agents and other substances hazardous to health, or work in compressed air.
- Health surveillance is important for:
- them getting worse
- Providing data to help employers evaluate health risks
- Enabling employees to raise concerns about how work affects their health
- Highlighting lapses in workplace control measures, therefore providing invaluable feedback to thc risk assessment
- ·Providing an opportumity to reinforce training and education of employees (e.g. on the impact of health effectsand theuseof protectiveequipment)
- Risk assessment should be used to identify any need for hcalth surveillance.It should not be used asasubstitute for undertaking ariskassessment orproviding/using effectivecontrols.

## 2.4.3.4.2. Medical and First Aid Provision:

有限责任公司

- >The Contractor shall provide medical facilities and services for all is staff and its Subcontractors personnel in line with Egypt Labor Law. This shall include services such as, but not limited to, physical examination for fitness to work, consultation and treatment of sickness and injuny and occupational health clinic. 8031
- A first aid station shall be provided and maintained at all times. The station shall be fully equipped to treat illness and injuries which can be expected to normally occur in work of the types required by the relevant project. The following requirements will also be adhered to;
- oMedical supplies shall be stocked in the types and quantities recommended by the designated doctor
- The first aid station shall be located near the main access to the Site(s), readily accessible to ambulance services
- The first aid station and the satellite site first aid boxes or cupboards shall be placed under the charge of the designated First Aid Attendant
